thread:
tariq.k: Idea: run a gated-credit "progressive unlock" test. Users get 30 credits up front, then can unlock an extra 120 by completing a short onboarding task (run & save a prompt). KPI = activation velocity + saved-prompt lift.

anya.v: Love the behavioral nudge angle. Quick Q: do we gate the extra credits behind a verification (email) or a product action? My vote = product action only. Keeps friction low.

ben.s: Product-action sounds right. Hypothesis: small up-front credit + task unlock should increase retention of new prompt authors. We'll measure 24hr run rate and pct who finish the onboarding step.

cleo.m: Messaging idea for landing + email:
- Headline: "Start with 30 free credits. Unlock 120 more when you ship your first prompt."
- Microcopy: "Try a curated starter prompt pack, run it once, save one tweak, and the rest of the credits are yours."

ops-bot: Note: please add utm_source=prog-unlock to all CTA links and tag leads with lead_source=prog_unlock in HubSpot.

anya.v: Routing: we'll split traffic into three cohorts: open-150 (no gate), gated-30+unlock, and control-50 (flat). Split 33/33/34. We need a feature flag for the landing to change copy/flows.

ben.s: Can GrowthOps do the feature flag + an analytics property unlock_flow_type? @ops-bot any concerns about fraud (people looping to claim credits)?

ops-bot: Flag ok. Add property claim_timestamp and a cooldown (24h) to prevent rapid reclaims. Also track ip and device_id for fraud signals.

cleo.m: Creative asks: 1) 4-frame demo GIF showing claim -> run -> save -> coins unlocked 2) short email with progress stepper 3) landing with progress microcopy and success toast.

tariq.k: For the short onboarding task, pick a starter prompt set focused on product copy and code generation (higher save rates). We'll include 6 templates but surface 3 on landing.

anya.v: Analytics spec (minimal): new_user_id, cohort, credits_granted, credits_claimed, prompt_run, prompt_save, unlock_event, paid_conversion_14d. Dash should show funnel conversion and time-to-unlock distribution.

ben.s: Quick experiment plan snippet: 
- name: prog_unlock_credit_test_v1
- cohorts: open_150, gated_unlock_30, control_50
- allocation: 33, 33, 34
- primary: 24h_prompt_run_rate
- secondary: save_rate, unlock_rate, 14d_conversion

cleo.m: Copy variants for email subject A/B:
A: "Claim 30 credits now  unlock 120 more when you ship a prompt"
B: "Ship a prompt, unlock 120 bonus credits  start with 30 free"

ops-bot: Reminder checklist: LD flag, utm params, hubspot mapping, cooldown, fraud logging, analytics events, GIF asset.

tariq.k: Who picks the templates? @cleo.m choose creative set, @ben.s you'll wire the run/save events, @anya.v analytics + dashboard, ops-bot for flags. I'll own the experiment writeup and hypothesis.

growth-bot: Suggestion: include a small eval to ensure the starter prompts don't hallucinate sensitive content. Link to eval run: https://internal/evals/prog-unlock-v1

cleo.m: I'll drop the GIF and copy into the drive by EOD and create a quick Figma for the landing.

ben.s: I'll add the LD flag and wire events to amplitude. ETA tomorrow morning.

anya.v: Dashboard template will be ready for the soft launch review. We'll run soft for internal users Thursday, public Friday 10am PT.

tariq.k: Nice. Last note: include a small survey on the success toast for those who unlock to capture why they saved the prompt (short checkboxes). Helps qualitative understanding.

ops-bot: Logged: experiment/prog_unlock_credit_test_v1 created. Assigned tasks to owners.

tariq.k: Thanks team 680. Sync tomorrow 9:30am for final sign-off.
